title: Four Blonde Punk Poses
description: Four identical cartoon illustrations of a female character with voluminous bright yellow hair, wearing a black and yellow punk outfit with 'NYC' on the chest, black boots, and fingerless gloves. She is shown in slightly varied standing poses pointing to the right against a solid dark gray background.
